captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a precision roll-axis rotary module. It features a hollow, light-grey rectangular support frame housing a dark-grey central cylindrical shaft. The shaft is supported by bearing cartridges, with a black square mounting plate and a dark-grey hexagonal cap on one exterior face. A small, cubic payload bracket is mounted directly to the central section of the internal rotating shaft.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a precision roll-axis rotary module with a single coaxial joint. The assembly should include a hollow rectangular support frame in light grey, a central cylindrical shaft spanning the interior, a black square bearing cartridge on the outer face with a dark-grey hexagonal end-cap, and a small cubic payload bracket attached to the shaft.
captions.factory: Construct the main support frame by subtracting a smaller box from a larger box to create a hollow rectangular shell. Model the rotating shaft using a cylinder, and add a small box to represent the payload bracket. Build the bearing cartridge on the side using a thin square box, a circular flange, and a hexagonal prism for the end-cap. Assemble these elements with appropriate materials and define a revolute joint representing the roll-axis rotation of the shaft and its bracket relative to the frame.
